tasks.title: Bundle attribution fields and schema updates
tasks.goal: Define attribution fields for plan/build items and update schema/docs.
acceptance_scenarios: Scenario: Given the bundle schema is loaded, when validating a plan/build item with attribution, then model and completed_at (RFC3339 UTC) fields are accepted and documented.
Scenario: Given the bundle schema is loaded, when validating a plan/build item with attribution, then optional reasoning_level is accepted when present.
Scenario: Given a bundle without attribution fields, when validating, then it still passes as backward compatible.
Scenario: Given TEMPLATE.bundle.json, when validating it against the bundle schema, then it passes.
tasks.notes: Schema should allow optional attribution fields to avoid forced migrations; model stored as runtime string with no normalization.

tasks.title: Capture attribution on plan/build completion
tasks.goal: Record model, completed_at, and commits when steps are marked done.
acceptance_scenarios: Scenario: Given a plan step is marked done, when the agent follows CONTRACT prompt guidance, then the bundle item includes model, completed_at (RFC3339 UTC), and optional commits list.
Scenario: Given a build work item is marked done, when the agent follows BUILD prompt guidance, then the bundle item includes model, completed_at (RFC3339 UTC), and optional commits list.
Scenario: Given no commit hashes are provided, when marking done, then commits may be omitted or an empty list.
tasks.notes: Update CONTRACT/BUILD prompts to require attribution on done steps; model is runtime string; reasoning_level optional.

tasks.title: Validate attribution rules
tasks.goal: Ensure done steps include required attribution fields and remain backward compatible.
acceptance_scenarios: Scenario: Given a bundle with at least one attribution field present, when validating, then every done plan/build item includes model and completed_at (RFC3339 UTC).
Scenario: Given a bundle with no attribution fields, when validating, then it passes attribution validation (legacy compatibility).
Scenario: Given a done item with commits omitted or empty and reasoning_level omitted, when validating, then it still passes if model and completed_at are present.
tasks.notes: Enforce in cbd verify; apply checks only when attribution is present to avoid breaking legacy bundles.

tasks.title: Optional reasoning_level backfill/input
tasks.goal: Allow adding reasoning_level attribution when the runtime does not provide it.
acceptance_scenarios: Scenario: Given a bundle item without reasoning_level, when a user provides a reasoning_level value, then it is stored without modifying other attribution fields.
Scenario: Given a bundle item with reasoning_level, when validating, then it still passes as optional metadata.
tasks.notes: Deferred; scope can be CLI flag or manual edit workflow.
